claim: A meta-review mechanism reduces evaluation variability while preserving central tendencies, leading to more stable and consistent assessments in multi-agent scientific discovery.
falsifier: In a multi-agent scientific discovery system, compare evaluation variability and central tendencies with and without a meta-review mechanism.

conditions: system uses multiple role-based agents including reviewer
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task, population, and conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Meta-review mechanism for evaluation variability reduction

claim: Human oversight is necessary to safeguard correctness, ethical considerations, and interpretability in AI-powered multi-agent systems for scientific discovery, but excessive oversight diminishes the benefits of autonomy.
falsifier: In an AI-powered multi-agent system for scientific discovery, vary the level of human oversight and measure the trade-off between correctness/interpretability and the degree of autonomy achieved.

conditions: when the system is used for scientific discovery
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Level of human oversight–correctness, ethical considerations…

claim: LLMs are limited to internal knowledge and cannot generate the necessary constraining information from real-world processes to truly reduce the hypothesis space; a scientific agent overcomes this limitation by obtaining information from the physical world.
falsifier: One could compare the hypothesis-space reduction achieved by an agent that can only use internal knowledge versus one that can perform experiments or query the physical world.

conditions: for tasks requiring reduction of hypothesis space beyond existing knowledge
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported theoretical framework and hypothesized conditions; transfer beyond the described setting is unestablished.

title: Obtaining constraining information–the hypothesis space mechanism
